answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the forge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, revoked by a single upheld challenge. Work waits on the ocean until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the inlet of the next round.
